<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The stores of a shop: name, a badge of its kind (pickup or store only), address, hours, phone, a note and the
  services. Axes: layout (cards, list: one row per store, map: compact cards beside a map picture), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Store, StoreLabels } from "./store-locations.types";

export type StoreLocationsProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  stores: Store[];
  empty?: string;
  kinds: Record<string, string>;
  labels: StoreLabels;
  layout?: "cards" | "list" | "map";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { at, cn, tpl, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  stores,
  empty = "",
  kinds,
  labels,
  layout = "cards",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<StoreLocationsProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :lead="lead" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((stores?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="store" :title="empty" />
    <Box v-else
      :class="cn(
        'grid grid-cols-1 gap-8',
        (((layout as string) === 'map') ? 'items-start md:grid-cols-2' : '')
      )"
    >
      <Box
        :class="
          (layout as string) === 'cards' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-2'
          : 'flex flex-col gap-4'
        "
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <Stack v-for="s in stores" :key="s.id"
          gap="4"
          :class="
            (layout as string) === 'list' ? 'border-b border-border pb-4'
            : 'rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6'
          "
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Stack gap="2">
            <Badge variant="outline" size="default" class="w-fit">
              {{ at(kinds, s.kind) }}
            </Badge>
            <Title :as="3" size="lg" weight="bold">
              {{ s.name }}
            </Title>
          </Stack>
          <List
            tag="ul"
            :class="
              (layout as string) === 'list' ? 'flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2 text-sm'
              : 'flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm'
            "
          >
            <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <LucideIcon name="map-pin" :size="16" />
              <Inline>
                {{ s.address }}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <LucideIcon name="clock" :size="16" />
              <Inline>
                {{ s.hours }}
              </Inline>
            </ListItem>
            <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-2">
              <LucideIcon name="phone" :size="16" />
              <Link :href="urlOf(tpl('tel:{0}', s.phone))" variant="default">
                {{ (s.phone ?? "").replaceAll(" ", "\u00a0") }}
              </Link>
            </ListItem>
          </List>
          <template v-if="((layout as string) === 'cards')">
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ s.note }}
            </Text>
            <Group gap="2" class="flex-wrap">
              <Badge v-for="v in s.services" :key="v" variant="secondary" size="default">
                {{ v }}
              </Badge>
            </Group>
          </template>
        </Stack>
      </Box>
      <Box v-if="((layout as string) === 'map')" class="md:sticky md:top-8">
        <MediaFrame :alt="labels.map" ratio="1/1" />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
